reason: I might take the free audit if it really is one call and an export, but I'm not paying £240 a month on spec. Our ticket categories are a mess, so I'd expect half the 'unbilled time' to be stuff we deliberately wrote off or miscoded, and I'd spend my evenings arguing with the report.
objection: The numbers will be wrong because our ticket categories are messy, so the findings won't survive me checking them, and I'm not sending a client an uplift email off a report I don't trust.
would_change_my_mind: The free audit turning up a few clients I can actually see are over their agreement, with tickets I'd agree with, and more than the £2,880 after I've thrown out the noise. Or another UK MSP owner on r/msp saying it worked on messy PSA data.
